name: Nekura na Classmate ga Ore no Ibukuro o Tsukande Hanashite Kurenai
original_name: 根暗なクラスメイトが俺の胃袋を掴んで放してくれない
source:
Now a sophomore, the protagonist Narita Hinata, is delighted to be in the same class as his familiar buddies. While chatting with his friends, he loses his balance and falls, desperately grabbing on to something......he feels, something soft. And then, what he sees, in white, a girl's underwear.

The girl's name is Kurano Kokage. Her bangs hide most of her face, gloomy vibes, a completely plain girl.

No matter how many times Hinata apologizes, Kokage never says a word. Feeling guilty, "I want to do something to make amends," and in respond, Kokage opens her lips "Come to my house, now."

In this title, with the encounter of Hinata and Kokage, marks the beginning of a bittersweet love story. 

[Translated and edited from [url=https://fes2022.product.co.jp/visualstyle/kinetic_information02.html]Visual Style[/url]]
translation:
现在是大二学生，主角成田日向很高兴能和他熟悉的伙伴们在同一个班级。在和朋友聊天的时候，他失去平衡摔倒了，拼命抓住什么东西……他感觉，有什么柔软的东西。然后，他看到了，白色的女孩内衣。

少女的名字叫藏野小影。刘海遮住了大半张脸，阴郁的气质，完全就是一个素颜女孩。

无论日向道歉多少次，小影都没有说话。小影感到内疚，“我想做点什么来弥补”，作为回应，小影张开嘴唇“现在就到我家来吧。”

在这个标题中，随着日向和小影的相遇，标志着一段苦乐参半的爱情故事的开始。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://fes2022.product.co.jp/visualstyle/kinetic_information02.html]视觉风格[/url]]
